sources.title: ReMM-SLERP-L2-13B original model card
sources.evidence: Calls the release Re:MythoMax (ReMM), a recreation of MythoMax using updated component models; documents the SLERP merge of ReML and Huginn v1.2, and an Alpaca text instruction template. Exact repository title labels the model 13B. Current accepted model-card metadata declares cc-by-nc-4.0. Freshly reopened for parameter re-audit: the recipe explicitly uses TheBloke/Llama-2-13B-fp16 as the TIES base for ReML and then SLERP-merges ReML with Huginn v1.2; its base-model metadata and Models used list identify the named Llama 2 13B lineage.

sources.title: Exact released checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: LlamaForCausalLM, 40 layers, hidden size 5120, intermediate size 13824, 40 attention and KV heads, vocabulary 32000, untied embeddings, max_position_embeddings 4096 and rope_scaling null. No expert, multimodal or quantization configuration. Specifies Transformers 4.32.1 and float32; card prose says fp16, so its storage precision is not assumed. Fresh comparison with the exact named base conversion config matches all parameter-determining dimensions; _name_or_path identifies Huginn-13b-v1.2. No layer expansion, expert expansion, new modality, changed vocabulary or structural pruning is indicated.

sources.title: Original PyTorch checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Maps 363 learned-weight names to three PyTorch .bin shards. Names comprise token embedding, final norm, LM head and forty layers of four attention projections, three MLP projections and two norms. No expert/router, vision or audio module names. The byte total alone is not treated as an exact learned-parameter count, and no large weight shard was downloaded.

sources.title: Llama implementation at configured Transformers version
sources.evidence: Defines dense causal Transformer with RMSNorm, bias-free Q/K/V/O projections, SiLU-gated dense MLP, token embedding and LM head. Rotary inverse frequencies and caches are nonpersistent buffers. Used with this exact config and tensor-name inventory to establish architecture; no claim that all storage shapes were inspected.

sources.title: Released tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: Llama text tokenizer with BOS/EOS/UNK definitions; no dedicated reasoning mode or function/tool-call chat protocol. Its huge model_max_length value is an unspecified tokenizer sentinel, not evidence of supported context.

sources.title: Original repository metadata and file inventory
sources.evidence: Public ungated checkpoint at revision 9cf491450795628e28b8fd73f411977f7908c623. Repository created September 4, 2023; original inventory has three PyTorch .bin shards and no safetensors or separate license file. Current owner-accepted card metadata declares cc-by-nc-4.0.

sources.title: Original repository commit history
sources.evidence: Original README and weights uploaded September 4, 2023; external README contribution merged by Undi95 September 9. These timestamps constrain the known repository history but do not by themselves identify the precise public launch day.

sources.title: Public original-repository contribution and creator merge
sources.evidence: An external user opened the exact model repository README contribution on September 9, 2023 at 20:32:59 UTC; Undi95 is marked repository owner and merged it at 20:34:50 UTC. Confirms public community availability in September, without treating the merge day as launch.

sources.title: Later ReMM v2 model card checked for exact-series context
sources.evidence: Names Re:MythoMax v2 / ReMM v2 as a separate updated-component SLERP merge. Establishes family naming but supplies no separate active-parameter count for the earlier original SLERP release; later variant details are not transferred.

sources.title: Provider listing used by downstream catalogs
sources.evidence: Lists July 22, 2023 and 6144 context for the routed API identifier. The listed date is not supported by the original repository history, which begins September 4; API context and unavailable tools describe that provider route, not the original checkpoint.

sources.title: Creator-owned GGUF variant card
sources.evidence: Describes quantized versions of the same ReMM SLERP merge, with matching components and Alpaca prompting; declares cc-by-nc-4.0. Checked for original availability/capability details; it does not disclose a separate active count or exact launch day.

sources.title: Mixtral of Experts: original Table 2 active-parameter comparison
sources.evidence: Table 2 explicitly labels its count column Active Params and gives LLaMA 2 13B = 13B. Section 2.1 distinguishes total parameters from parameters used to process an individual token. This is Mistral's published nominal comparison convention for the exactly named base, not a Meta or Undi95 disclosure and not an exact participation census.

sources.title: Exact named Llama 2 13B merge-base conversion card
sources.evidence: States these fp16 files are Meta's Llama 2 13B, made by downloading Meta PTH files and converting to Hugging Face format; supplies the conversion command with model_size 13B. This is the exact base named in the ReMM recipe, not a merely similar model. Its mirrored original Meta card also lists the 13B pretrained variation.

sources.title: Exact named Llama 2 13B merge-base configuration
sources.evidence: LlamaForCausalLM with 40 layers, hidden size 5120, intermediate size 13824, 40 attention heads, vocabulary 32000 and untied embeddings. These parameter-determining dimensions exactly match ReMM's released configuration; ReMM additionally makes its 40 KV heads explicit.

sources.title: Creator-linked SLERP implementation at freshly resolved revision
sources.evidence: Interpolates corresponding state-dict tensors, constructs AutoModelForCausalLM from the primary model configuration, loads the merged state dict and saves that model. The current creator-linked implementation supports a weight merge retaining the configured architecture; it is not evidence of runtime routing or expansion into an ensemble. The exact release config and index independently establish the resulting structure.

sources.title: Original named airoboros 2.1 component card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact named component as an instruction fine-tuned llama-2 model using synthetic airoboros data. Describes data and prompting changes, with no structural parameter-count alteration or separate active count.

sources.title: Original named Nous Hermes Llama 2 component card
sources.evidence: Names Nous-Hermes-Llama2-13b and describes instruction fine-tuning on over 300,000 instructions at sequence length 4096. No structural parameter-count alteration or separate active-count disclosure is described.

sources.title: Huginn v1.2 original card text mirrored by its quantizer
sources.evidence: The mirrored original card describes merges of chronos, airoboros, hermes and beluga, subsequently mythologic and ledgerdemain, plus a limarp LoRA. Used only as corroboration for the named merge lineage; the original Huginn repository now returns HTTP 401 and this mirror does not independently establish an active count.

sources.title: Later exact-model provider documentation checked for parameter claims
sources.evidence: May 2026 documentation lists exact ReMM-SLERP-L2-13B as total 13B and calls active parameters N/A because the model is dense, followed by prose asserting all 13B are active. The provider explicitly says it did not develop or train the model and derived the documentation from public sources. Corroborative only: the active assessment instead uses Mistral's explicit nominal Active Params column and verified named lineage, not a generic dense-equals-active rule.

This is not an exact checkpoint tensor census: original PyTorch storage shapes/dtypes were not all read, and index bytes or later conversions are not substituted for that measurement.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 13B inferred through the developer-documented Llama 2 13B TIES/SLERP merge lineage from Mistral AI's original Mixtral Table 2, whose Active Params column explicitly lists LLaMA 2 13B as 13B. The released architecture dimensions match the named base and the complete index retains the ordinary 40-layer Llama module inventory, with no structural pruning, expert expansion or added modality indicated. TIES merge-density settings are not treated as runtime pruning. This is the attributed base-model comparison convention, not an exact token-dependent count or a separate active-count disclosure by Undi95.

architecture.note: Exact config and complete indexed module names match a forty-layer Llama causal decoder Transformer with dense gated MLPs, RMSNorm and 40-head multi-head attention. No MoE router or expert modules.

context_window.note: Original checkpoint configured window is 4096 with no RoPE scaling. Replaces the hosted 6144 limit; provider context extension and the tokenizer unspecified-length sentinel do not alter the original model configuration.

modalities.note: Text tokenizer, Alpaca prompting and causal language-model modules; no configured/indexed vision or audio branches.

reasoning.note: No exact-model developer reasoning mode or training claim is established. Clear unsupported false rather than infer general incapability from absent documentation.

tool_call.note: The author supplies Alpaca instruction prompting without a tool protocol. Hosted endpoint tools being unavailable does not establish model-wide absence of function-calling ability; clear unsupported false.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit preserves nominal 13B total and resolves nominal active parameters to 13B through the documented unchanged Llama 2 13B merge lineage and Mistral AI's original Active Params comparison. The precise checkpoint total and token-level participation are not claimed. All twelve other field assessments are preserved, including 4096 original context, September 2023 month precision and declared CC-BY-NC-4.0 license.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain developer nominal 13B total; resolve nominal 13B active via explicit unchanged Llama 2 13B merge lineage and Mistral AI's published comparison convention.
parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Reopened the exact pinned creator card, config and index; exact named base conversion card/config; original airoboros and Hermes component cards; creator-linked SLERP code; original Mistral Mixtral Table 2; and later creator ReMM v2/GGUF cards. Searches also recovered 2026 exact-model provider documentation and a Huginn original-card mirror, retained only as corroboration. No distinct later creator active-count definition or structural size change was found. The active count is not obtained by equating dense with active or by summing merge components.
parameter_reaudit.structural_check: Compared LlamaForCausalLM, model type, 40 layers, width 5120, MLP width 13824, 40 heads, vocabulary 32000 and untied embeddings against the explicitly named base configuration. All match. ReMM states 40 KV heads. Its index has 363 learned-weight entries in 3 shards and no expert/router, vision or audio modules. SLERP implementation retains the primary model configuration. Merge-density recipe values do not establish structural runtime pruning.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: Original Huginn v1.2 card/config, Chronos-Beluga-v2 card, private ReML card and Meta Llama 2 13B raw card returned HTTP 401; none is represented as accessed evidence. The exact creator merge recipe, public named base conversion sources and released structure establish lineage; the Huginn original-card mirror is explicitly secondary.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: 13B total remains nominal rather than an exact storage census. Active 13B follows Mistral's nominal base-model comparison convention through the documented merge, not a separate fine-tuner disclosure or exact token-dependent participation measurement.
